unit.why: A single anecdote: a hasid sends tobacco to the Seer of Lublin through the rabbi of Shinyava, and the Seer perceives the 'scent of first fruits' that the messenger had intended.

stories.start_quote: בס׳ ייטב לב פ׳ תולדות וזה"ל
stories.summary_en: R. Yaakov of Shinyava sends tobacco to the Seer of Lublin through the rabbi of Shinyava, who silently wishes his delivery to count as bringing first fruits; on smelling it, the Seer says it smells of bikkurim.

quotes: והריח בו אמר שמריח ריח ביכורים
tags.why: The Seer perceives the messenger's unspoken thought.
A gift of tobacco is the object of the wonder.

quotes: המביא דורן לת"ח כאלו מביא ביכורים
tags.why: A gift to the tsaddik counts as bringing first fruits.
The grandson heard the story from his grandfather.

quotes: כך עלה במחשבה של זקיני ז"ל
tags.why: The author's grandfather is the protagonist.

quotes: איש אחד חסיד ועשיר מן שינאווא
tags.why: A wealthy hasid sends a gift to the tsaddik.

quotes: הרי לא אמרו הנותן דורן לת"ח
tags.why: Contains an exegesis of a rabbinic dictum.

missing_concepts: tsaddik reading thoughts through the sense of smell
